about: a progress bar draws a 2 px frame and, 2 px inside it, a fill floor((w - 4) * value + 0.5) wide with value clamped to 0..1 (none when that is 0 or the box has no inner height); `enabled` is neither checked nor drawn; stripes are filled polygons, the bands along the bottom edge joined into polygons of at most 128 points, drawn before the corner bands along the top; with a skin the whole bar is the normal look and the leading floor(w * value + 0.5) px the selected look cut from the full-width look (without a selected look inkemu cuts the normal look inverted the same way); a value that is NaN, not a number or missing, an unknown style or skin is invalid_argument; the bar is never hit, so a tap reaches the control below (looks, validation and the tap observed on the reader's UI library as a black box)
